tickets.title: Fix the navigation bar responsiveness
tickets.body: The main navbar overflows on mobile screens smaller than 375px. Need to adjust CSS breakpoints and convert menu items into a collapsible burger menu layout.

tickets.title: Add dark mode toggle to user settings
tickets.body: Users are requesting a dark theme option. Need to introduce CSS custom properties for theme colors and save user preference in localStorage.

tickets.title: Update broken footer links
tickets.body: The links for Privacy Policy and Terms of Service in the footer return 404 errors. Need to route them correctly to the updated legal pages.

tickets.title: Optimize image loading speed on landing page
tickets.body: Hero section banner images are over 5MB. Compress asset sizes and implement lazy loading to improve initial page load metrics and lighthouse score.

tickets.title: Fix CORS error on payment gateway integration
tickets.body: API requests to the checkout endpoint are getting blocked due to missing headers in the backend response. Need to update cross-origin resource sharing policies.
